description: OFFLINE, NO GAMEPLAY CHANGE. Renames the matchmaking host string 'pes22-game.cs.konami.net' to 'pes99-game.cs.konami.net' inside your own eFootball.exe, so the client cannot reach Konami's servers and starts straight into offline play. Two ASCII bytes in the string table; no code is touched and gameplay is byte-identical to vanilla. This is the whole difference between the vanilla exe and the 'offline' exe used for Master League play. Reversible with `python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/offline-no-gameplay-change.json`; Steam's 'verify integrity' also reverts it. Offline single-player on an owned copy only. Located by searching the exe for the host string (find), so it survives game updates that move it; module_offset is the address in build 25359256 (2026-11) for tools that read it directly.
